maria_sales: Heads up — Acme Sec team just sent the SIG/CAIQ and they want clarifications on our key management posture (BYOK/HSM), rotation, and POC requirements. Can @sam_sec and @alex_infra weigh in so I can update the questionnaire?

alex_infra: Short answers first: in-transit is TLS 1.2+ (mutual TLS available for Private). At-rest: AES-256-GCM. For hosted we use cloud KMS (customer or Redwood-managed). We support BYOK via customer-managed KMS (AWS/GCP/Azure). If customer requires HSM-backed keys (FIPS 140-2 L2/L3), we can integrate customer HSM or partner HSM — this requires an SOW and network setup.

sam_sec: Additions: key rotation is supported. If customer brings keys, they control rotation cadence; we can also trigger rotation hooks and support zero-downtime swaps. Auditability: full audit events (model call, key usage) surfaced in the Console and exported to customer SIEM via our logging pipeline.

maria_sales: They specifically asked if Redwood stores plaintext keys or escrow.

alex_infra: We DO NOT persist plaintext customer key material. For BYOK, Redwood never holds plaintext private key material; we reference customer CMKs via KMS APIs. For HSM-provisioned flows where Redwood is given a connection to the HSM, keys remain in the HSM.

sam_sec: For the SIG/CAIQ, here is a suggested snippet to drop in under encryption/KMS:

```
Redwood supports encryption in transit (TLS 1.2+) and at rest (AES-256-GCM). Customers may bring their own keys (BYOK) via supported cloud KMS providers (AWS KMS, GCP KMS, Azure Key Vault) or via customer-managed HSMs. When BYOK is used, Redwood does not store plaintext key material; cryptographic operations occur via the customer's KMS/HSM. Key rotation policies are customer-configurable; Redwood provides rotation hooks and audit logs. For customers requiring HSM-backed FIPS-certified keys, Redwood integrates with customer-provided HSMs under a defined SOW.
```

gloria_cust_success: Quick ops note for POC: Acme wants the HSM path for their Dedicated POC. We can demo the KMS flow first but they'll require HSM in the evaluation and eventually production. Pricing: HSM adds a fixed monthly surcharge + per-connection setup. I'll draft a cost estimate.

maria_sales: Can we do live key rotation during the POC without bringing the environment down? They asked this specifically.

alex_infra: Yes — we support rolling key swaps. Typical approach: provision new CMK/HSM key, update service config to reference new key, then we gradually migrate active KV caches/objects. There's a short overlap window but no full downtime. I can write a 1-page runbook for the customer.

sam_sec: CAIQ-specific: if they ask about key escrow or split-knowledge, we should be explicit: Redwood does not escrow customer keys. If split-knowledge (M-of-N HSM) is required, customer must provide the HSM or partner arrangement; Redwood will integrate but does not perform key custody. Also include link to our security docs: https://redwood.example.com/security/kms (for the SIG reference).

maria_sales: Good — I'll paste that snippet into the questionnaire. @gloria_cust_success can you own drafting the SOW for the HSM add-on and an estimate for procurement time?

gloria_cust_success: :thumbsup: Will do. Expect SOW + estimate by end of day. Procurement timeline estimate: 3-7 business days for partner HSM orders, ~3 business days for network/VPN config, ~5 days for Redwood config and tests.

deploy_bot: deploy: created acme-poc-hsm-env (poc-env-1764012345)

sam_sec: Last security callouts to include in SIG answers: default rotation recommendation = 90 days (customer-controlled), we provide rotation hooks and audit trail. For BYOK/HSM flows, clarify that Redwood never has access to plaintext private key material and that cryptographic operations are performed in the customer's KMS/HSM. Also call out that transport uses TLS 1.2+ and recommends mutual TLS for Private deployments.

maria_sales: Perfect — I'll update the SIG/CAIQ doc with the snippet and send it back to Acme. No objections to phrasing "FIPS support via customer-provided HSM" rather than implying Redwood manages the HSM?

sam_sec: Agree — be explicit about "customer-provided HSM" to avoid misunderstanding.

maria_sales: Thanks everyone — will share the updated questionnaire and the POC SOW.
